summary.text: Joseph Claeys is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 27 (Sedgwick County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2025.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Claeys is listed as a member of the Judiciary Committee, the Local Government, Transparency and Ethics Committee, the Transportation Committee and the Utilities Committee.
The Legislature lists Joseph Claeys's occupation as School Psychologist.
